scope: Local synthetic-byte protocol regression; no distributed R70, TURN, physical-device or public-NAT qualification.

failure.trigger: A media request arrives while the same peer has a changed-ticket online admission check pending.
failure.before: The upload rechecks the old ticket, sees a different pending credential and closes the accepted link as an admission refusal.
failure.baselineRegression: The focused renewal test fails on the base commit with closed != open. The baseline was loaded through a temporary Node module hook without modifying the checkout.
failure.after: The upload joins the pending bounded check. Only acceptance allows media and quota. A retired connection cannot spend quota after admission accepts.

native.heldAdmission: No media or quota before the real held HTTP response accepts.

historicalR70.retainedDiagnosis: Far-end discovery replacement closed receiver-2's only link during the sampled renewal window. This admission-overlap fix does not establish distributed retention.

baselineExpectedFailure.assertion: pending renewal does not close a live link when media is requested; closed != open
baselineExpectedFailure.hook: Temporary module hook loaded the base commit loader with the current regression; removed after recording.

validation.initialConcurrentSuiteRun: One pre-existing short-deadline signalling test failed while the full suites ran concurrently. The unchanged test passed in the final full JavaScript rerun.
validation.documentation: docs:generate and check:docs passed; 28 authored files and 436 repository links.
validation.hostedCI: Not run on this branch at the local evidence checkpoint.
